newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs seen having positive bias in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs seen having positive bias in Tokyo.

text.p: JGBs are expected to have a positive bias on Wednesday in expectation of an accommodative Bank of Japan credit stance following steep rises in the money market rates, traders said on Wednesday.
The BOJ let the money market have 400 billion yen on Tuesday in an attempt to cap a further rise in the market rates.
The key three-month certificates of deposit was issued at 0.70 percent on Tuesday, the highest rate since August 7, 1996.
Traders said that part of the 400 billion yen of 1.9 percent six-year JGBs offered by Ministry of Finance on Tuesday were left unsold in the market.
But they were likely to be absorbed by the market without difficulty in the short-term given the bullish market trend, they added.
The Finance Ministry said on Monday that it would reduce its bimonthly issues of four- and six-year JGBs to 400 billion yen from 500 billion yen.
